# AudioPad - LLM Access Information

- **Website**: https://audiopad.vercel.app
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/audiopadapp/audiopad/

## What is AudioPad?
AudioPad is a free, open-source soundboard for Windows and Linux that plays audio files through your microphone with low latency, hotkeys, and no telemetry or accounts.

## Key Features
- Free & open-source (GNU GPLv3 License)
- Native apps for Windows 10/11, Linux
- Virtual audio device setup (no manual config)
- Drag-and-drop audio file management
- Global hotkeys for instant playback
- Low-latency performance
- No telemetry, no accounts, no cloud
- Works with Discord, Zoom, Teams, OBS, games, etc.
